title: Riot-848
extract:
Riot-848 is  Temple's signature machine pistol which is modified by Albrecht Entrati to recall bullets upon reloading, causing the bullets to explode dealing  Blast damage as they fly back into the gun's chamber.

Characteristics
The primary fire deals pure  Puncture damage.
Bullets lodge into surfaces. Upon reloading, the bullets explode in a 1.5 meter radius before flying back to the wielder.
Recall explosion deals  Blast damage.
Explosion does not need direct line of sight to deal damage and will penetrate walls.
Does not inflict self-stagger.
Can benefit from  Fulmination ( Primed).
A maximum of 32 rounds can be embedded at any given time. Additional rounds will cause the earliest round to automatically detonate and fly back without reloading the gun.
Reloading while holstered effects such as  Eject Magazine does not trigger explosions.
Does not use ammo pickups.

Acquisition
Riot-848's main and component blueprints can be obtained from Stage Defense Solstice Square in Höllvania. Access requires completion of The Hex Quest being Rank 4 - Hot & Fresh with  The Hex Syndicate.
Alternatively Riot-848's blueprints can be purchased from Flare of  The Hex, requiring Rank 4 - Hot & Fresh, using  Beating Heartstrings awarded from Stage Defense. Each component blueprint requires 60  and the main blueprint requires 120 , totaling 300  Beating Heartstrings for the whole set.

All drop rates data is obtained from DE's official drop tables stored on Module:DropTables/data.
See Mission Rewards#Standard Missions for definitions on reward table rotations.
For more detailed definitions and information,
visit here.

Notes
While firing, guitar sounds can be heard as the clip reaches the last 25% of its magazine (by default, the last 4 rounds), and upon an empty reload, a guitar riff can be heard.
Riot-848's icon uses an incorrect image showing the magazine separated from the receiver.
Despite having a reload gimmick moderately similar to  Cantare, only the explosions from the final shot benefit from  Synth Charge.
Punch Through has no effect on this weapon.

Bugs
Specters can run out of ammo when using Riot-848. This includes specters created by  Celestial Twin or  Duality.
They can restore ammo from ammo pickups.
